facts.fact: The Rule of Law and Accountability Advocacy Centre, in a statement on Saturday 18 July 2026, urged the National Assembly to withdraw or revise parts of the Nigeria Data Protection (Amendment) Bill, 2026 that could let regulators shut digital platforms.
The document says the Federal Government suspended Twitter in Nigeria in 2021, a suspension the ECOWAS Court of Justice found incompatible with freedom of expression; no day or end date is given.
